name: drift-check
description: When a reply does not start with your marker emoji (CLAUDE_REPLY_MARKER), asks Claude to check that reply against CLAUDE.md and fix what slipped.

marker.title: Marker emoji
marker.description: The emoji every reply must start with (e.g. 🌊). Add the rule "Start every message with <emoji>" to your CLAUDE.md. Empty: the check stays idle. CLAUDE_REPLY_MARKER in settings.json env takes precedence.
